description: Edited directly, not generated: the map-figma-component skill writes an entry. npm run gen copies it into components.gen.json, and checks/figma-library.mjs holds it to Figma. Each entry is the Figma component's name and the node id of the component or component set (its link's node-id, - as :), or null when Figma has none. Deliberate differences: codeOnly is keyed by a code prop Figma has no variant for, with why. figmaOnly is keyed by a Figma variant code has no prop for, with how code chooses it, starting 'In code'. valuesDiffer is keyed by a code prop whose values differ from Figma's on purpose, with why.

codeOnly.tooltipSide: Where its tooltip opens: Figma draws the tooltip on its own.

figmaOnly.Type: In code, href makes an External link (a web address) and onClick a View link (a screen in the app).

figmaOnly.Action: In code, on when the action prop holds a TextFieldAction.

codeOnly.side: Where it opens beside its trigger.

codeOnly.pulse: An animation: Figma draws the dot at rest.

valuesDiffer.tone: current takes its words' colour, which Figma draws as each status.

codeOnly.density: Figma has the row, not the list: a list's spacing is its frame's gap.

codeOnly.align: Not in Figma yet: a value with no text baseline sits on the row's middle.

figmaOnly.Has label: In code, on when the label prop is set.

figmaOnly.Value: In code, the value prop, a number from 0 to 4.

figmaOnly.Mix: In code, the down and up props: Mixed has both, Down only has up at 0, Empty has both at 0.

figmaOnly.Neutral: In code, color="neutral"; any other colour is a tint.
In code, color="neutral": the hollow ring.
figmaOnly.Last: In code, no prop: CSS draws a list's last node without its line down.

codeOnly.as: The HTML element: it looks the same.

figmaOnly.Openable: In code, on when the onOpen prop is set.

figmaOnly.Size: In code, no prop: it sizes in em to its line. Display is a hero figure's size, Compact a row's.

figmaOnly.Page: In code, the page whose NavItem has isActive.

figmaOnly.Back: In code, on when the onBack prop is set.
